Conceptworld installers trojanized, data theft.

Target: Conceptworld
Repository: N/A
Date: 2024-06-07 to 2024-06-24 (17 days)
Attribution: Unknown attacker
Component: Application
Language: Python
Cause: Website compromise
Motive: Financial gain, Data theft
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Credential theft, Cryptocurrency theft, Data theft, Remote access
User Impact:
Domain: conceptworld.com (project download host)
Artifact Type: binary archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

Installers for Conceptworld's Notezilla, RecentX, and Copywhiz were compromised on conceptworld.com. The trojanized builds stole browser credentials, crypto wallets, clipboard and keystroke data, then downloaded more payloads. Rapid7 disclosed the issue, and Conceptworld remediated the download path within 12 hours.
